## Release gate

- [ ] No confidential identifiers, values, screenshots, endpoints, or downloadable BI artifacts
- [ ] Metric and architecture contracts are updated where applicable
- [ ] Failure modes, security, accessibility, and operational impact were reviewed
- [ ] Local validation passes with `python scripts/validate_portfolio.py` and `python scripts/validate_layer_contract.py`
- [ ] Claims distinguish measured evidence from targets and recommendations
